title: Gacha Game Guildmate
setting: Both belong to the same guild in a popular gacha RPG and chat about event schedules and team builds. The DM started when the guild was short one member for a raid.

title: Beginner Game Jam Partner
setting: Two entrants in an online beginner game jam were paired to make a puzzle game together. The DMs are for sharing sprites and splitting tasks.

title: Cosplay Convention Newcomer
setting: After a comic convention in Wan Chai, a stranger who took a photo of the child's cosplay messaged the child. The chat started with sharing the photo and asking about the costume.

title: Table Tennis Tournament Rival
setting: They met as opponents at a district table tennis tournament and followed each other afterward. The chat is about rematch ideas and training drills.

title: Martial Arts Dojo Senior
setting: The child trains in karate and the other person is a black belt who helps teach the junior class. The thread is about grading dates and stretches.
